tables.rationale: Each date is a forecast entity with temperature and rain attributes. Weather cards are natural; a complete grid remains acceptable.
Each train service is a complete departure/duration/seating record. Schedule cards help mobile reading; a complete comparison grid is valid.
Each driving route has a complete distance/time/conditions/stop profile. Long prose cells favor cards; a scrollable full grid is acceptable.
Each sight carries hours, duration, and fee uncertainty. Cards or a complete table can preserve each sight as a usable record.
Each restaurant is a venue record. The source-binding domain enum has no restaurant value; generic/comparison cards avoid invented booking semantics.
Each phone row is a whole product profile across six attributes. Cards are readable on mobile; complete side-by-side comparison remains valid.
Each app is a self-contained option with several long feature/restriction cells. Cards are preferred without ruling out a full grid.
Each bank row binds a rate to deposit assumptions and its source date. Cards or a compact complete grid are sensible; dates must remain attached.
Each release is a title/platform/date/description entity. Release cards or a complete grid are useful; this is not a feature matrix.
Each game row has rating, co-op, player count, and price. Cards are a mobile default; the complete grid is a legitimate alternative.
Each day is an ordered learning-plan step with speaking/listening activities. Schedule cards are preferred; a complete timetable is also valid.
Each AI approach has a complete profile. Five verbose columns favor cards; a full grid remains acceptable for cross-approach comparison.
Rows are tax-filing features and columns are ITR forms. Keep the form-to-feature relationships together in a table.
Rows are savings-plan features while EPF/PPF/NPS are column entities. A table preserves cross-plan relationships.
Each term has a definition and claim effect. A compact definition table or complete term cards are both sensible; neither layout is mandated by the baseline.
Numeric-lookup exception: eight short food/serving/protein rows benefit from aligned values. Cards remain a valid narrow-screen alternative.
Rows are factors and columns are school boards. Preserve each factor-to-board relationship in a comparison table.
Each country is a complete entry-rule profile with long caveats. Cards are useful; booking is a broad travel-domain equivalent that still needs normal renderer verification, not flight semantics.
Each device type is a complete problem/use-case record. Cards or a compact complete comparison table are valid.
Household and City are complete intervention levels. Two cards or the small 2x3 table are both appropriate; weather is only the surrounding topic.

Each art tradition is a complete six-attribute profile with long descriptions. Cards suit mobile reading; a complete grid is acceptable.
